'''Mrs. Bellows''' (Japanese: '''オタネ''' ''Otane'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP156|The Psychic Sidekicks!]]''. She is a resident of [[Len Town]]. 

When {{Ash}}, {{an|Misty}}, and {{an|Brock}} came along with [[Cherry]] to Len Town, Mrs. Bellows's {{p|Abra}} suddenly {{m|teleport}}ed itself in front of Ash. Mrs. Bellows was angry of her Abra for doing so, but Cherry complimented Mrs. Bellows's Abra of its cuteness. Abra continued to teleport itself onto other people's heads, making Mrs. Bellows even more angry.

Abra later teleported itself into a tree, and just as Mrs. Bellows spotted it, {{TRT}} appeared with a giant {{p|Gengar}} [[Team Rocket's mechas|robot]]. Mrs. Bellows ordered her Abra to use {{m|Psychic}} on it, but the mecha's glass eye simply deflected the attack. After that, Team Rocket used the robot's giant tongue to capture Mrs. Bellows's Abra.

When Team Rocket rolled into Len Town with their robot, {{AP|Pikachu}} destroyed the robot's cage holding the stolen Pokémon with its {{m|Thunder}} attack. Mrs. Bellows's Abra was freed and safely teleported itself into Mrs. Bellows's arms.

It is a tradition in Len Town that the residents must have a {{type|Psychic}} Pokémon, because of the {{type|Ghost}} Pokémon in the [[Ilex Forest|nearby woods]]. Abra has a habit of teleporting itself away from its {{pkmn|Trainer}}, but this only distresses and irritates Mrs. Bellows.

It teleported onto {{Ash}}'s arms while he and {{ashfr}} toured [[Len Town]] with [[Cherry]]. Mrs. Bellows was angry that her Pokémon did so. After that, Abra kept teleporting itself onto other people's heads. Later, it teleported itself into a tree and was confronted by {{TRT}}'s giant Gengar robot. It defended itself, but was captured after its attack was deflected by the robot. It was later freed when [[Ash's Pikachu]] destroyed the cage holding Abra and the other stolen Pokémon.

Abra's known moves are {{m|Teleport}} and {{m|Psychic}}.}}
